title: M-MAP — the colony map: top-down, and nothing on screen that is not real
desc:
DELIVERABLE: the map in dreamer2664/mars — a top-down static page (no frameworks, no build step; the vigil pattern: plain ES modules, system fonts, resilient fetch, visible freshness) that reads ONLY app/world.json, plus tools/world_build.py (deterministic compiler world/ -> app/world.json) and a push-driven workflow republishing it (cron is unreliable on this account — push is the clock).
Locations: command center (PC holder, purpose, since, queue, availability), one studio per colonist (current video/thread/channel), meeting room (ONLY real thread/meeting records), archive, production facility, entrance. Clicking anything opens its source record verbatim. Freshness from generated_ts; amber past 45 min.
EVIDENCE: the phantom check — a build test that fails if any rendered entity has no source record (inject a fake avatar, watch the build fail, remove it); local serve against a fixture world; a headless smoke test booting the page (the vigil smoke.mjs pattern).
HARD RULE: nothing on screen that is not a record (CHARTER section 3). No filler, no invented motion.
OWNS: app/, tools/world_build.py, the page workflow.
BRANCH: agent/<you>/<task-id>
